summary: Stratus Properties Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to a construction loan agreement for its Holden Hills Phase 1 project. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement — a credit facility modification — not a special situation. The amendment extends the maturity to August 2027, increases the commitment by ~$9.9M, and adjusts interest rate terms. No change of control, buyout, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. This is standard debt financing activity with no shareholder vote or special committee involvement. No deal terms, premium, or close dates apply. The filing is purely operational and does not trigger any special-situation category.
